name: @emsenn/organizing-as-lakota
description: Organizing as Lakota — the Lakota fiber over @emsenn/organizing: a library of lakotaean becoming presented on the relating→animating→organizing web. The capstone fiber, so the whole becoming-chain arrives through organizing's imports: the four superior Wakȟáŋ (Tóbtób Kiŋ) ARE relating's four charges (the captain's substantive claim — the bilattice is Lakota cosmogony in algebraic notation, not the reverse), discharging is the cosmogonic settling out of Íŋyaŋ-in-Haŋhépi (the initial ⊤), wakȟáŋ is a cell-and-rule quality, and mitakuye oyasin is the global kinship-cosmos theorem. Built cosmogony-first; the kinship, lifeway (wólakȟota), and governance/wicozani tiers build up from here.
